projects.title: SkillCourt
projects.description: Designed and developed SkillCourt.com to showcase a proof of concept Interactive Athletic Training System. The architectural design pattern used was an MVC model. The Backend was developed using Parse.com, a Back end as a Service resource. Front end developed using Javascript, jQuery, PHP, and Processing.js.
